formula_in_my_words: Let d be the smallest number of single-character insertions, deletions or replacements needed to change recognized text into the reference, and n be the number of reference characters. The reported cer is d/n; the percentage is 100*d/n. Here punctuation is included.
input_and_line_explanation: reference is 請推薦不辣的晚餐。 and recognized is 請推薦辣的晚餐。. text_error_report compares those strings and returns a dictionary. edits holds the minimum operation count, reference_characters the count of the correct string, and cer their ratio. The print calls retrieve those values. *100 converts the fraction to a percentage, round(..., 1) shows one decimal place, and reference == recognized checks exact equality.
